name: Cyclone
description: The same spiral wound the other way, and tighter.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 2%; top: 38%; width: 96%; height: 24%; border-radius: 999px; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transform: rotate(@calc(@atan2(2 * @y / @Y - 1 - 1 / @Y, 2 * @x / @X - 1 - 1 / @X) * 57.2958 - 110 * @sqrt(@abs(2 * @x / @X - 1 - 1 / @X) * @abs(2 * @x / @X - 1 - 1 / @X) + @abs(2 * @y / @Y - 1 - 1 / @Y) * @abs(2 * @y / @Y - 1 - 1 / @Y)))deg); transform: rotate(@calc(@atan2(2 * @y / @Y - 1 - 1 / @Y, 2 * @x / @X - 1 - 1 / @X) * 57.2958 - 110 * @sqrt(@abs(2 * @x / @X - 1 - 1 / @X) * @abs(2 * @x / @X - 1 - 1 / @X) + @abs(2 * @y / @Y - 1 - 1 / @Y) * @abs(2 * @y / @Y - 1 - 1 / @Y)))deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
